context_requirements: Expression of TOP1 and/or TOP2A/TOP2B (all lines express at least one)
Intact DNA damage response signalling (ATM/ATR, CHEK1/2)
TP53 wild-type or functional for robust CDKN1A/GADD45 induction (A375, A549, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP have functional p53; HA1E is transformed and may be less responsive)
Proliferating cells for cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis readouts
falsifiers: No induction of CDKN1A, GADD45A, or other p53 targets at 6 h in any line
No reduction of proliferation/cell-cycle genes (CCNB1, CDK1, AURKA) at 24 h
No DNA damage response signature (no up-regulation of TP53BP1, no down-regulation of cell-cycle genes) at either time point
Response identical in all nine lines regardless of p53 status
No apoptosis signature at 24 h despite strong cytotoxicity

evidence.supports: Topoisomerase inhibitor beta-lapachone induces apoptosis in human cancer cells, with ROS involvement and resistance in high-GSH lines
Topoisomerase inhibitor beta-lapachone activates JNK and caspase-3 via an oxidation-dependent pathway
Topoisomerase inhibitor SH-7 stabilizes Topo II-DNA cleavable complex and elevates phosphorylated H2AX, inducing apoptosis
Topoisomerase inhibitor TAS-103 induces DNA cleavage and H2O2-mediated apoptosis with caspase-3 activation
Dehydroebriconic acid inhibits topoisomerase II activity
